protocol: DTU 24/37/40/55/63, 49 views, 800x600, 30k, 3M max splats, surfel mesh-goal (apply_surfel_defaults). ON = main defaults (MV geo .03 ncc .15, every 3rd step x3). OFF = config_overrides surfel-mv-geo-weight 0, surfel-mv-ncc-weight 0. Both arms trained back to back in ONE fal exec per (scan, seed) on the same RTX PRO 6000 runner, order rotated by seed. Arm A = product TSDF mesh (no mask); arm C = official 2DGS extraction (object mask, keep-1, per-scan unit-converted voxel/trunc/cut). Each scored with the B15 scorer and the official 2DGS scorer (hbb1 f3e3b9f scripts/eval_dtu). Harness = G1's catchup.py (sha256 146755c2...) + run_dtu_g1.py (f74c7dd4...), recovered from fal /data blobs by hash.
statistics_verdict: Registered MV gate (per-seed 5-scan ON-OFF means, n=3, mean beyond 2*SD, all seeds < 0) PASSES on arm C and arm A, on both scorers. Row 5: ON arm C 3-seed mean 0.5893 (B15) / 0.5882 (official) vs official 2DGS 0.6020 / 0.6017 = -0.013 / -0.014 mm: PARITY under the g1-mesh-catchup band rule (within +/-0.05; band-based, not a statistical equivalence claim); 4/5 scans better by point estimate (scan 37 only by 0.0003 / 0.0006 mm); scan 40 worse by +0.043 (B15) / +0.045 (official). Default decision: KEEP as a PROVISIONAL default on the registered dev pass, pending the internal held-out-scene (sealed generalisation) gate; generalisation beyond the dev scenes is NOT verified, and the garden-1M landing-memory condition is not established.
